value.rationale: The tetrahedron is the minimal triangulation of the sphere, and elementary type-I/type-II cocycles are basic generators of the cocycle normal form. The result resolves the first representation-independent lower-bound question left after the anchor natural-star construction in this canonical setting: flatness does not erase the level-p carry. It is a structural boundary result, not an arbitrary finite slice, while its limitations keep it short of the broader phase conjecture.
